summary: Your classic coloring book for all. Relax & de-stress. No color by number!
description:
Welcome to ColorMe: Coloring Book, the free art game for everyone.

Tired of "color by number" apps that pick your colors for you? Rediscover creative freedom with a classic coloring experience. ColorMe is your personal anti-stress therapy, giving you a blank canvas to relax, unwind, and express yourself.

Why You'll Love ColorMe:

🎨 TRUE CREATIVE FREEDOM (NO "COLOR BY NUMBER") This is a real drawing app for all ages. You are the artist! Choose your own colors from hundreds of palettes. There are no numbers to follow—just relaxing, creative fun.

🧘 ANTI-STRESS & RELAXATION Unwind after a long day. This is your personal color therapy for anxiety relief and mindfulness. It's a perfect calming activity for both adults and children.

🖼️ OVER 500+ FREE PAGES Our massive library is updated daily. Explore intricate mandalas, beautiful flowers, majestic animals, cute cartoons, butterflies, and more. There's a page for every mood and skill level.

🖌️ REAL DRAWING TOOLS Get creative with pencil drawing modes, watercolor painting effects, and more. Make every picture your own unique sketch or painting.

📶 PLAY OFFLINE (NO WIFI) No internet? No problem. Color your favorite pages anywhere, anytime. Open your favorite pages online once, and they'll be available for you to enjoy offline.

✨ FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY (KIDS & ADULTS) Our app is designed for everyone! It features a huge selection of coloring pages, from easy drawings for kids (dogs, cartoons) to complex, intricate drawings for adults (mandalas, flowers).

More Features:

New Pages Added Daily: The fun never stops with new, free coloring sheets added all the time.

Massive Color Selection: Choose from over 200 colors and create custom palettes.

Share Your Art: Save and share your beautiful creations with family and friends.

Note: All pictures are suitable as coloring books for adults and kids. This is a classic drawing app, not a "color by number" game.

Download ColorMe now and start coloring your stress away!
